name: Lauren Young Tire (Roseburg)

nadir.desc: The property consists of a large commercial facility with multiple connected and detached buildings and light-colored roofs|A large paved parking surrounds the structures|Extensive outdoor tire storage is located along one side of the property in organized rows|The facility has direct frontage on to Northeast Stephens Street with open access from the road.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows the main building complex with multiple service bays and garage openings facing the street|A large paved customer and vehicle parking area is located in front of the buildings|The site has clear road frontage and access, with open paved maneuverability around the structures.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side of the multi-building complex|Large quantities of tires are stored in organized rows along this side of the property|Paved areas provide vehicle movement between the buildings and the tire storage zone.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back of the multi-section building complex with additional service and storage areas|Outdoor tire storage and open paved spaces extend across portions of the rear and side of the property|Vehicle movement is available around the main structures.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the main buildings with service areas and paved parking|Open space surrounds this side of the complex|The property maintains clear access and visibility of the building elevations from multiple approaches.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from Northeast Stephens Street into the large paved parking and areas surrounding the building complex. The open layout provides good space for emergency vehicle staging in front and around the sides of the facility. Outdoor tire storage occupies a significant portion of one side of the property and may limit movement in that zone. The main buildings have multiple service bay openings. The facility is located in a commercial corridor with good road frontage and neighboring properties.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the property, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the main buildings? Is vehicle access available through all areas of the tire storage zone? Are there any gates or barriers controlling access to the rear or storage areas of the facility?
